names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 mai, «Sfântul Cuvios Gheorghe Ivirul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Μαΐου, «Όσιος Γεώργιος ο Ίβηρας», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

death.note: The title of doxologia.ro's page for him: «Viața Cuviosului Gheorghe Ivirul (†1066)». The body of the page gives no year, only that he fell asleep at Constantinople on 24 May.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

feast.note: doxologia.ro's calendar keeps him on 13 mai with the other Iberian founders, and its own page for him ends «Deși a adormit pe 24 Mai, georgienii prăznuiesc pomenirea lui pe 30 iunie, rânduindu-l împreună cu Sfinții Apostoli. Se cinstește pe 13 Mai.» — so the page itself names three days and settles on this one.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 mai — «Sfântul Cuvios Gheorghe Ivirul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Γεώργιος ο Ίβηρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar already keeps him on — and the Romanian row already carries a note that doxologia.ro's own page for him names three days and settles on this one. saint.gr adds no fourth day. **He is none of the corpus's many other Georges**, which the namesweep flagged and which were read; the office settles it. **The Greek entry is one sentence long** and it is the one thing the corpus wanted: «εξελέγη ηγούμενος της μονής των Ιβήρων του Αγίου Όρους μετά την παραίτηση του Οσίου Ευθυμίου και κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη» — elected abbot of Iviron after the resignation of the venerable Euthymius, and asleep in peace. **Note the word «παραίτηση», resignation**: Euthymius's own page on the same day says he died at Constantinople in 1028 and says nothing of resigning, and saint.gr is not reconciled here — the difference is recorded and nothing is inferred from it. **No year at all**, so the existing `dates` object is not touched and nothing is added to it. **Euthymius is linked.** No hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).
